what: A 4em round ”More” button. When it enters the screen, two outline rings expand from 1 to 2x over 2s (strongest halfway) and fade away, twice, with the second ring trailing 1s behind like a ripple. On hover the text settles down .5em first, the wave icon follows .1s later (.4s), and a surrounding circle larger than the button (5.33em) is drawn in one turn over .6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1). On release the circle is erased along the same path and the icon returns first.

options.on: With load the ripple fires as soon as it is attached (the original hangs a hidden button as the trigger so every button lights up the moment it opens) · by default it fires when the parent enters the screen
options.hide: If 0, visible even before entering · default is hidden until entering (original display:none)
options.ripple: Length of one ripple (seconds), default 2 — the second ring lags by half of that
options.ring: Length (sec) of drawing the surrounding circle, default .6
options.dur: Time for text and icons to settle down (s), default .4
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: (if present) surrounding circle SVG — if absent, the part creates a radius 39 circle

use: More

from.note: Original: ripples 2000ms linear × 2 · :after delayed 1000ms · circle stroke-dashoffset 245 → 0 600ms var(--new-ease-out) · text transform 400ms 100ms
